change: Prepare and warm Crystal off the main thread once per shared renderer resource set; preview draws video until ready, then redraws paused frames; icons and exports share immutable resources.
measurement_scope: Production preparation and renderer, isolated optimized app. Main-actor heartbeat during first setup; not the whole editor.
caution: Before/after runs have different driver-cache states. These measurements demonstrate nonblocking setup, not a total setup-time speedup or full-editor frame-rate guarantee.

export_validation: Exact output pixels matched the original full-quality Crystal encode for the regression scene. Crystal shader and ray/bounce counts unchanged.
